title: Remote viewing Jesus as a personality-profile target

tellings.quote: good guy. And uh that's when the monitor opened the um envelope and our director had written the word Jesus on it.

plain: In the 1980s, a military remote viewing unit, whose members tried to describe hidden targets using only the mind, was asked to build a personality profile of a sealed target, and the envelope, once opened, held the word "Jesus," written there by the unit's director. Lyn Buchanan, an Army sergeant who served as a remote viewer in the unit, tells it first-hand, recalling that the session had described a good person before the envelope was opened.
